    client.settings.signingSecret

    签名密钥管理

    2 个方法

    应用管理员读取或主动轮换 ek 签名密钥。

    GETsettings.signingSecret.get()读取用户令牌签名密钥＋
    /signing_secret#

    令牌：仅 ak（管理员） · 自动模式默认使用 ak · 权限与协议来源

    Returns this app's signing secret (signing_secret), the value used to sign ek-* (external user) tokens on the app side: md5(signing_secret + app_id + user_id + expired_time). Sensitive key material; reads are audit-logged. api_key is never returned. Requires an app admin token (ak-*).

    调用签名

    TypeScript
    client.settings.signingSecret.get(
  options?: ZAIRequestOptions
): Promise<SettingsSigningSecretGetResponse>

    所有方法最后均可传入 ZAIRequestOptions；示例中的 ID 请替换为真实值。

    调用示例

    TypeScript
    const result = await client.settings.signingSecret.get();
console.log(result);

    返回值 SettingsSigningSecretGetResponse

    HTTP 200 · application/json

    结构：object

    字段类型存在性说明 / 约束
    app_idstring保证存在App id
    signing_secretstring保证存在Signing secret for ek-* tokens
    token_prefixstring保证存在Token prefix produced with this secret
    HTTP 状态与原始接口定义
    状态规范说明SDK 行为
    200Signing secret正常返回
    401Unauthorized: missing or invalid bearer token抛出 ZAIClientError，保留可用的 status 和 body
    403Forbidden: requires an app admin token (ak-*)抛出 ZAIClientError，保留可用的 status 和 body
    500App has no signing secret configured抛出 ZAIClientError，保留可用的 status 和 body

    下方保留完整 HTTP 规范，包含嵌套字段、联合类型、默认值、约束及所有响应。SDK 的文件上传与流式开关以上方说明为准。

  "path": "/signing_secret",
  "tags": [
    "App Settings"
  ],
  "summary": "Get the ek-* signing secret for this app",
  "description": "Returns this app's signing secret (`signing_secret`), the value used to sign ek-* (external user) tokens on the app side: md5(signing_secret + app_id + user_id + expired_time). Sensitive key material; reads are audit-logged. api_key is never returned. Requires an app admin token (ak-*).",
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Signing secret",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "app_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "App id"
              },
              "signing_secret": {
                "type": "string",

    POSTsettings.signingSecret.regenerate()重新生成用户令牌签名密钥＋
    /signing_secret/generate#

    令牌：仅 ak（管理员） · 自动模式默认使用 ak · 权限与协议来源

    Generates a new signing secret and persists it immediately. The previous secret is invalidated, so any ek-* tokens signed with it will stop verifying. The new secret can be read back at any time via GET /v1/zai/signing_secret. Generation is audit-logged. Requires an app admin token (ak-*).

    密钥轮换会使旧 ek 签名失效。成功后对相关 provider 或自动客户端的 client.auth 调用 invalidate({signingSecret: true})；SDK 不自动轮换或重试请求。

    调用签名

    TypeScript
    client.settings.signingSecret.regenerate(
  options?: ZAIRequestOptions
): Promise<SettingsSigningSecretRegenerateResponse>

    所有方法最后均可传入 ZAIRequestOptions；示例中的 ID 请替换为真实值。

    调用示例

    TypeScript
    const result = await client.settings.signingSecret.regenerate();
console.log(result);

    返回值 SettingsSigningSecretRegenerateResponse

    HTTP 200 · application/json

    结构：object

    字段类型存在性说明 / 约束
    app_idstring保证存在App id
    signing_secretstring保证存在Signing secret for ek-* tokens
    token_prefixstring保证存在Token prefix produced with this secret
    HTTP 状态与原始接口定义
    状态规范说明SDK 行为
    200Newly generated signing secret正常返回
    401Unauthorized: missing or invalid bearer token抛出 ZAIClientError，保留可用的 status 和 body
    403Forbidden: requires an app admin token (ak-*)抛出 ZAIClientError，保留可用的 status 和 body
    404App not found抛出 ZAIClientError，保留可用的 status 和 body
    500Failed to regenerate the signing secret抛出 ZAIClientError，保留可用的 status 和 body

    下方保留完整 HTTP 规范，包含嵌套字段、联合类型、默认值、约束及所有响应。SDK 的文件上传与流式开关以上方说明为准。

The new secret can be read back at any time via GET /v1/zai/signing_secret. Generation is audit-logged. Requires an app admin token (ak-*).",

            /** @description The identifier exactly as it appeared in the request, echoed so results can be matched by index. */
            requested: string;
            /** @description Resolved model id, or null when the request carried an empty identifier. */
            model: string | null;
            /**
             * @description Capability the probe was resolved against; null when the model has no probeable capability. Determines the upstream path: text.chat via /chat/completions (or /responses when the model declares Native Responses API), text.embeddings via /embeddings.
             * @enum {string|null}
             */
            capability: "text.chat" | "text.embeddings" | "image.generate" | "image.edit" | "image.variation" | "audio.transcribe" | "audio.translate" | "audio.speech" | null;
            /**
             * @description Authorization state, checked before any billable request. 'ok' = the app may call this model; 'not_configured' = the request carried an empty model id; 'model_not_found' = no such model exists; 'unauthorized' = no enabled ability for the app owner's user group, no enabled channel, or the model is not available to this app. A non-'ok' value short-circuits: no upstream request is sent and charged_calls is not incremented.
             * @enum {string}
             */
            access: "ok" | "not_configured" | "unauthorized" | "model_not_found";
            /** @description Upstream connectivity result, or null when not probed (short-circuited by a non-'ok' access). Deliberately carries no upstream URL: this is an app-facing API, and the probed channel may be a platform-owned one whose base_url the app cannot read through GET /channels. Diagnose from kind, http_status and message instead. */
            probe: components["schemas"]["ModelTestProbe"] | null;
        };
        TestSettingsModelsResponse: {
            /**
             * @description Aggregate verdict. 'unhealthy' = at least one model is unauthorized, missing or empty; 'degraded' = all are authorized but at least one probe failed or could not be sent; 'healthy' = every probe succeeded.
             * @enum {string}
             */
            status: "healthy" | "degraded" | "unhealthy";
            /** @description Number of billable upstream requests this call actually issued. 0 when every entry short-circuited. */
            charged_calls: number;
            /** @description One entry per requested id, in request order. */
            results: components["schemas"]["ModelTestResult"][];
        };
        TestSettingsModelsRequest: {
            /** @description Model ids to test, 1 to 20 entries. Results come back in the same order. Each id must be a model this app may call; ids the app has no access to are reported as unauthorized rather than rejected, so a bulk check stays diagnosable. */
            models: string[];
        };
        SettingsChannel: {
            /** @description Channel id */
            id: number;
            /** @description Channel type; 1 = OpenAI compatible */
            type: number;
            /** @description Channel display name */
            name: string | null;
            /** @description Upstream base URL */
            base_url: string | null;
            /** @description Model ids bound to this channel */
            models: string[];
            /** @description Whether the channel is enabled */
            enabled: boolean;
            /** @description Masked API key; plaintext is never returned */
            key: string;
            /** @description Creation timestamp */
            created_at: string;
        };
        UpdateSettingsChannelRequest: {
            /** @description New upstream base URL */
            base_url?: string;
            /** @description New upstream API key */
            api_key?: string;
        };
    };
    responses: never;
    parameters: never;
    requestBodies: never;
    headers: never;
    pathItems: never;
}
    createZAIClient＋

    创建资源客户端。baseUrl 必填，auth 与 getToken 二选一，返回 ZAIClient。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export declare function createZAIClient(options: CreateZAIClientOptions): ZAIClient;
    CreateZAIClientOptions＋

    客户端构造选项：API 根地址、Token 提供器、自定义 Fetch 和默认请求头。

    TypeScript
    export type CreateZAIClientOptions = {
  /** API root including /v1/zai. Relative URLs are supported in browsers. */
  baseUrl: string;
  fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch;
  headers?: HeadersInit;
} & (
  | {
    /** Called before each request: true selects ak; false selects ek. Return the token without Bearer. */
    getToken: (admin: boolean) => string | Promise<string>;
    auth?: never;
  }
  | {auth: ZAIAutoAuthOptions; getToken?: never}
);
    createZAIToken＋

    使用服务端凭据签发 Token。expiredTime 默认为当前 Unix 秒加 1000。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export declare function createZAIToken(appID: string, appKey: string, userID: string, expiredTime?: number, userName?: string): string;
    createZAITokenProvider＋

    创建按请求缓存并续期的 Token 提供器，支持缓存失效和永久释放。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export declare function createZAITokenProvider(options: ZAITokenProviderOptions): ZAITokenProvider;

    ZAIAutoAuthOptions＋

    服务端自动鉴权：按每个操作的权限选择 ak 或 ek。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIAutoAuthOptions extends ZAICredentials {
  mode: 'auto';
  expiresInSeconds?: number;
  refreshBeforeSeconds?: number;
  signingSecretTimeoutMs?: number;
}
    ZAIClient＋

    createZAIClient 的返回类型，包含全部资源方法、doctor 诊断方法与自动鉴权生命周期 auth。

    TypeScript
    export type ZAIClient = ReturnType<typeof createZAIClient>;
    ZAIClientError＋

    SDK 错误类；按 code 分支处理，可附带 HTTP 信息、errorInfo 及 cause。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export class ZAIClientError extends Error {
  constructor(code: ZAIErrorCode, message: string, options?: ZAIErrorOptions);
  readonly code: ZAIErrorCode;
  readonly status?: number;
  readonly body?: unknown;
  readonly errorInfo?: ZAIErrorInfo;
  readonly method?: string;
  readonly path?: string;
  readonly headers?: Headers;
}
    ZAICodingEvent＋

    Coding 事件完整载荷，保留未知扩展字段。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAICodingEvent {
  seq: number;
  type: string;
  turn_id: string | null;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}
    ZAICodingStreamEvent＋

    Coding SSE 数据帧，含事件名称、游标、原始 JSON 和完整事件对象。

    TypeScript
    export type ZAICodingStreamEvent = Omit<Extract<ZAIStreamEvent, {type: 'data'}>, 'data'> & {data: ZAICodingEvent};
    ZAICredentials＋

    服务端签名凭据：appID、appKey、userID 及可选 userName。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAICredentials {
  appID: string;
  appKey: string;
  userID: string;
  userName?: string;
}
    ZAIDoctorDetail＋

    单项检查的类型、名称、是否通过、说明和可选错误。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIDoctorDetail {
  type: 'config' | 'httpProtocol' | 'server' | 'agents' | 'chat' | 'cleanup';
  name: string;
  pass: boolean;
  message: string;
  error?: Error;
}
    ZAIDoctorOptions＋

    doctor 选项：真实对话开关、Agent 与模型选择、每次请求超时、取消、请求头及进度回调。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIDoctorOptions extends ZAIRequestOptions {
  /** Send a short message in a temporary session. Defaults to false. Consumes model usage. */
  chat?: boolean;
  /** An active custom Agent. Defaults to the default active custom Agent, then the first available one. */
  agentId?: string;
  /** Model name passed to an enabled chat probe; otherwise the server selects its default. */
  model?: string;
  /** Timeout per request, including cleanup. Defaults to 30,000 milliseconds. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
  /** Called once per completed check. Callback exceptions propagate after any session cleanup. */
  onChange?: (detail: ZAIDoctorDetail) => void;
}
    ZAIDoctorResult＋

    诊断整体结果、逐项详情、选定 Agent 和临时会话 ID；清理失败也使 pass 为 false。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIDoctorResult {
  /** All requested checks, including temporary session cleanup, passed. */
  pass: boolean;
  summary: string;
  details: ZAIDoctorDetail[];
  /** The selected active custom Agent, if one was found. */
  agentId?: string;
  /** The temporary session ID, retained even after cleanup to help diagnose cleanup failures. */
  sessionId?: string;
}
    ZAIErrorCode＋

    六个稳定错误类别：authentication、http、network、aborted、invalid-input、invalid-response。

    TypeScript
    export type ZAIErrorCode = 'authentication' | 'http' | 'network' | 'aborted' | 'invalid-input' | 'invalid-response';
    ZAIErrorInfo＋

    服务端结构化诊断：code、message、reason_code、user_message、details 和可选 retryable。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIErrorInfo {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  reason_code: string;
  user_message: string;
  retryable?: boolean;
  details: Record<string, unknown>;
}
    ZAIErrorOptions＋

    构造 SDK 错误时使用的可选上下文。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIErrorOptions {
  cause?: unknown;
  status?: number;
  body?: unknown;
  method?: string;
  path?: string;
  headers?: Headers;
}
    ZAIRequestOptions＋

    所有资源方法的末尾选项：AbortSignal、单次请求头、显式幂等键和令牌类型。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIRequestOptions {
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  headers?: HeadersInit;
  /** Override the default token selection when the operation permits it. */
  tokenType?: 'admin' | 'user';
  /** Reuse this key when retrying the same write. Required operations generate one when omitted. */
  idempotencyKey?: string;
}
    ZAIRunnerStatusStreamEvent＋

    Runner 状态 SSE 数据帧，含 event、id?、rawData 和 unknown 类型的 data；正常 EOF 结束。

    TypeScript
    export type ZAIRunnerStatusStreamEvent = Extract<ZAIStreamEvent, {type: 'data'}>;
    ZAIStreamEvent＋

    SSE 数据事件或完成事件；data 以 unknown 保留。 查看使用指南 →

    TypeScript
    export type ZAIStreamEvent =
  | {type: 'data'; event: string; id?: string; rawData: string; data: unknown}
  | {type: 'done'};
    ZAIToken＋

    Token 与有效期；expiresAt 使用整数 Unix 秒。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAIToken {
  token: string;
  expiresAt: number;
}
    ZAITokenProvider＋

    异步 Token 获取函数，附带 invalidate 清除缓存与 dispose 永久释放方法。

    TypeScript
    export interface ZAITokenProvider {
  (): Promise<string>;
  /** Clear the token and cancel pending acquisition; optionally also clear the signing secret. */
  invalidate(options?: {signingSecret?: boolean}): void;
  /** Clear cached tokens and signing secrets and permanently stop token acquisition. */
  dispose(): void;
}
    ZAITokenProviderOptions＋

    credentials 与 fetchToken 二选一，支持提前续期窗口；fetchToken 接收共享获取信号并有独立超时。

    TypeScript
    export type ZAITokenProviderOptions = {
  /** Renew before a request when this many seconds (or less) remain. Default: 60. */
  refreshBeforeSeconds?: number;
} & (
  | {
    credentials: ZAICredentials;
    /** Lifetime of a locally signed token in seconds. Default: 1000. */
    expiresInSeconds?: number;
    fetchToken?: never;
    acquireTimeoutMs?: never;
  } & (
    | {tokenType?: 'admin'; baseUrl?: never; fetch?: never; headers?: never; signingSecretTimeoutMs?: never}
    | {
      tokenType: 'user';
      /** API root including /v1/zai, used to retrieve this app's signing secret. */
      baseUrl: string;
      fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch;
      headers?: HeadersInit;
      /** Independent timeout for the shared signing-secret request. Default: 30000. */
      signingSecretTimeoutMs?: number;
    }
  )
  | {
    /** The shared acquisition owns this signal; pass it to the backend fetch. */
    fetchToken: (signal: AbortSignal) => ZAIToken | Promise<ZAIToken>;
    /** Independent timeout for shared external token acquisition. Default: 30000. */
    acquireTimeoutMs?: number;
    credentials?: never;
    expiresInSeconds?: never;
    tokenType?: never;
    baseUrl?: never;
    fetch?: never;
    headers?: never;
    signingSecretTimeoutMs?: never;
  }
);

    export type ZAIUploadFile = Blob | {blob: Blob; filename: string};
